**`frontend/src/pages/FightList.tsx:206-219`** — the fight-list card badge:
```tsx
{needsRoundReview(fight) && (
  <p style={{ margin: '4px 0 0', fontSize: 12, color: '#f59e0b', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 5 }}>
    <span className="material-symbols-outlined" style={{ fontSize: 15 }}>rule</span>

```
Imported at `frontend/src/pages/FightList.tsx:11` (`needsRoundReview` from `../types/Fight`). It only renders inside the `ready` branch (fight is `completed`/`labeling_complete`), alongside `FightPurposeBadge`.

There's a sibling banner with the same underlying condition on the Annotate page: **`frontend/src/pages/Annotate.tsx:540-565`**, headed "Round boundaries are unverified", showing `selectedFight.segmentation_review_reason` as its body text. Imported at `Annotate.tsx:16`.

## 2. Condition controlling visibility

Both call the same predicate, defined in **`frontend/src/types/Fight.ts:106-113`**:
```ts
/**
 * Segmentation could not corroborate its own round list against the scoreboard,
 * so the rounds are a detection-only guess and should be confirmed by hand.
 * The pipeline sets this at segmentation time — see ai/video_processing/
 * fight_segmentation.py `_review_verdict`.
 */
export const needsRoundReview = (fight: Fight): boolean =>
  fight.segmentation_needs_review === true;
```
So the controlling field is `Fight.segmentation_needs_review` (boolean), declared in `frontend/src/types/Fight.ts:13` (with a companion `segmentation_review_reason: string | null` at line 14, used as the explanatory text in Annotate.tsx).

This is unrelated to labeling status — it's purely about whether AI round-segmentation was scoreboard-corroborated at pipeline time. It is **not** currently gated by any manual-labeling-complete flag, so it stays visible even after labeling finishes (unless something else clears the underlying DB column).

## 3. Field(s) indicating "manual labeling finished"

The data model's manual-labeling-finished signal is the fight's `state` field, not a boolean flag:

- `frontend/src/types/Fight.ts:100-101`: `isLabelingReady(state) => state === 'labeling_in_progress'`
- `frontend/src/types/Fight.ts:96-97`: `isFightViewable(state) => state === 'completed' || state === 'labeling_complete'`
- State transition target `'labeling_complete'` plus timestamp `labeled_at` (set together) — `backend/app/services/fight_service.py:171-204`, specifically the `UPDATE` at line 186: `"UPDATE fights SET state = 'labeling_complete', labeled_at = now() ..."`.
- `Fight.labeled_at: string | null` — `frontend/src/types/Fight.ts:9`. Per backend/CLAUDE.md, this is "the durable ground-truth-finalised marker — distinct from `state`, which resets when a labelled fight is re-run through the AI pipeline."

So: `fight.state === 'labeling_complete'` (or non-null `fight.labeled_at`) is the field to check for "manual labeling finished."

## 4. Backend/API code supplying these flags

- **`segmentation_needs_review` origin (the "unverified" flag):**
  - Set by the AI pipeline at segmentation time: `ai/video_processing/fight_segmentation.py:184` calls `_review_verdict(...)` (defined at line 211), whose result is persisted via `ai/database.py:54` `set_segmentation_review(...)` (SQL `UPDATE fights SET segmentation_needs_review = :needs, ... ` at line 68).
  - Model/column: `backend/app/models/fight.py:33` (SQLAlchemy `Column`) and `:55` (Pydantic default `segmentation_needs_review: bool = False`).
  - Never written by the labeling flow — per `backend/CLAUDE.md`: "written by the pipeline via `ai/database.py`'s `set_segmentation_review`, never by labelling."

- **"Labeling finished" origin:**
  - `POST /fights/{fight_id}/finish-labeling` route: `backend/app/api/routes/fights.py:267-270`.
  - Implementation: `backend/app/services/fight_service.py:171` `finish_labeling(fight_id)` — gated by `rounds_fully_annotated()` (`backend/app/services/label_span_service.py`, raises `NotFullyAnnotated` at `fight_service.py:166-168` if any round lacks a confirmed `round` label-span), then flips `state` to `labeling_complete` and stamps `labeled_at` (`fight_service.py:184-199`), notifying via `pg_notify('fight_state', ...)`.
  - Frontend call site: `frontend/src/services/api.ts` exposes `finishLabeling(...)`, invoked from `Annotate.tsx`'s `handleFinishLabeling`.

**Conclusion for suppressing the badge post-labeling:** there is currently no code path that ties `segmentation_needs_review` to labeling completion — they're independent columns. To suppress "Rounds unverified" once manual labeling is done, the `needsRoundReview` predicate (`frontend/src/types/Fight.ts:112-113`) would need to also check fight state/`labeled_at`, e.g. `fight.segmentation_needs_review === true && fight.state !== 'labeling_complete'` (and mirror that in `Annotate.tsx:540`'s condition) — or, on the backend, `finish_labeling()` in `fight_service.py` could additionally clear `segmentation_needs_review` when it flips state to `labeling_complete`.</result>

input.new_string:
/**
 * Segmentation could not corroborate its own round list against the scoreboard,
 * so the rounds are a detection-only guess and should be confirmed by hand.
 * The pipeline sets this at segmentation time — see ai/video_processing/
 * fight_segmentation.py `_review_verdict`. Once labeling is complete, every
 * round has a hand-confirmed label-span (finish-labeling requires it), so the
 * guess has already been confirmed and the warning no longer applies.
 */
export const needsRoundReview = (fight: Fight): boolean =>
  fight.segmentation_needs_review === true && fight.state !== 'labeling_complete';

content.text:
This shared predicate feeds both the fight-list badge and the Annotate page banner, so I checked the Annotate.tsx call site too — since that banner only ever shows while a fight is `labeling_in_progress` (before finish-labeling flips state to `labeling_complete`), this change doesn't alter its behavior, only the fight list's.

Updated [Fight.ts:112-114](frontend/src/types/Fight.ts:112) so `needsRoundReview` also requires the fight not be in `labeling_complete` state — once manual labeling finishes, every round has a hand-confirmed span (finish-labeling enforces that), so the "unverified" warning no longer applies and the [FightList.tsx](frontend/src/pages/FightList.tsx:206) badge will stop showing.
